title: Back-Alley Liquidity Shakedown
speaker: Valerie V. (Yandere Crypto Bro)
narrative: A neon shadow steps out from behind the dumpster holding a cold-storage ledger. Valerie smiles with unhinged affection: 'Darling! Tell me you didn't sell our memecoins at the bottom. Tell me we're going 100x long together... right now.'

choices.text: Pledge allegiance to the 100x margin long and hand over your wallet seed phrase.
Try to explain risk management, stop-loss orders, and diversified index funds.
